title: BIRD COLLECTORS CARDS IN COLLE...
reason: Generic title hides about 16 Tuckfield's Teas card albums, a niche Australian collectable that sells to collectors if reasonably complete.
findings: The title does not say what these are: about 16 Tuckfield's Teas Australiana card albums (script reads Tuckfield's, with Ty-Nee Tips, Tango and Orange Pekoe printed on the fish album page). They are spiral-bound 'Bird Studies' albums in several colours (legible card ranges include 1 to 96, 97 to 192 and 289 to 384, with several duplicate editions, one 'with notes for birdwatchers'), a Fish Series album, three koala-cover 'Australian Animals' booklets, a poodle-cover booklet and a 'Cats and their care' booklet. Inside pages photographed (fish cards 17 to 20, honeyeater cards 149 to 152, bird cards 277 to 280, cat cards 1 to 4) have the cards pasted in, so those albums look filled; how complete the other albums are was not shown. No web price check was possible, so strength is from general knowledge.
condition: Good for age: light cover wear and bent corners on the soft covers; the pages shown are clean with cards firmly in place.
rescore_note: About 16 Tuckfield's Teas card albums (Bird Studies, Fish, Animals, Cats), a common Australian collectable with duplicate editions and unknown completeness for most, so low to mid $80 to $200 band. General knowledge, no web check.
